cuts.head: with_body
cuts.placeText: a fencing hall — a long strip of floor with lines, a rack of foils, a wall of protective masks, polished wooden floor
cuts.scene: she is a fencer with one hand on her hip, looking down along the blade of a fencing foil in the other hand
cuts.outfit: a fencer look fitted to her body — a fitted white fencing jacket cut short at the hips over a short pleated fencing skirt, bare legs, white shoes, a silver feather-shaped crest on the jacket
